newsitem.title: USA: Dean Foods sees Q4 in line/better than consensus.
newsitem.headline: Dean Foods sees Q4 in line/better than consensus.

text.p: Dean Foods Co chief financial officer William McManaman said Thursday he expects fiscal fourth quarter earnings will be in line with or little better than the First Call consensus of $0.63 a share.
"I think we ought to be in line with First Call, maybe a little bit better," McManaman said in a telephone interview.
Earlier, Dean Foods reported stronger than expected third quarter earnings of $0.51 a share, above the First Call consensus of $0.44, and up from $0.17 a year ago.
Dean Foods shares were up 5/8 at 33-7/8 after trading as high as 34-3/8 earlier in the day.
